raw_response:
I am 65 years old, farming these 6 mu in Quzhou for 45 years. I never went to school. My father taught me, and now I watch my neighbors. If Old Wang's wheat looks good, I do what Old Wang does.

For the winter wheat: I plant improved seed after the maize comes off in autumn. Before sowing, I spread one full bag of compound fertilizer on each mu — one bag is 50 jin. When the wheat turns green in spring, I topdress half a bag of urea on each mu. That is what I did last year and I got about 1000 jin per mu. I irrigate three times from my well: once before the ground freezes so the wheat can survive winter, once in April when it starts jointing, and once in May when the ears are filling. I spray weed killer once in early spring, and once for bugs when the wheat is heading. After the maize harvest, I rotary till the ground to make it soft for wheat sowing.

For the summer maize: After I cut the wheat in June, I plant hybrid maize seed the same day. Everyone uses hybrid now — the old seed cannot compare. I put down one bag of compound fertilizer per mu at planting time, then spread half a bag of urea when the maize is knee-high. I irrigate twice: once in July if the rain does not come, and once in August when the ears need water. I spray herbicide once after the seedlings come up, and once for corn borer when I see the moths flying around the lamp at night. After wheat harvest I rotary till the stubble because I must plant fast before the soil gets too dry.

I worry about money every day. A bag of compound fertilizer costs over 150 yuan now, and urea is more than 120 yuan a bag. For 6 mu of wheat I need 6 bags of compound and 3 bags of urea. The maize needs the same. That is thousands of yuan just for fertilizer. But I dare not use less. If the crop fails, I lose everything. Last year I got about 1000 jin of wheat and 1200 jin of maize per mu. This year I will do the same. Everyone in the village uses about one bag of compound and half a bag of urea per mu. I do what they do.
